+

+def joint_row(spec, obs):
+    """Hold measured arm and torso joints while issuing a base command."""
+    layout = obs.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
+    values = dict(zip(layout, obs.meta["proprio"]["now"]))
+    row = np.zeros(25, dtype=np.float32)
+    for i in range(4):
+        row[3 + i] = values[f"torso_joint{i + 1}"]
+    for i in range(7):
+        row[7 + i] = values[f"left_arm_joint{i + 1}"]
+        row[16 + i] = values[f"right_arm_joint{i + 1}"]
+    row[14:16] = 0.07
+    row[23:25] = 0.07
+    return row
+
+
+def drive(r, dx=0, dy=0, dyaw=0, steps=1, label="drive"):
+    obs = r.get_obs()
+    row = joint_row(r.spec(), obs)
+    row[:3] = [dx / steps, dy / steps, dyaw / steps]
+    actions = np.repeat(row[None], steps, axis=0)
+    stop = row.copy()
+    stop[:3] = 0
+    actions = np.vstack([actions, np.repeat(stop[None], 4, axis=0)])
+    res = r.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=1 / 30, interpolate="hold", video="both", depth=True, note=label)
+    res.save(str(OUT / label))
+    print(json.dumps({"label": label, "done": res.done, "reason": res.meta.get("reason"),
+                      "steps": res.meta.get("control_steps"), "base_pose": res.group("base_pose", now=True).tolist(),
+                      "time_left_s": res.meta.get("time_left_s")}, indent=2))
+    return res
+
+
+def main():
+    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()

+    p.add_argument("--dx", type=float, default=0)
+    p.add_argument("--dy", type=float, default=0)
+    p.add_argument("--dyaw", type=float, default=0)
+    p.add_argument("--steps", type=int, default=1)
+    p.add_argument("--label", default="run")
+    a = p.parse_args()

+        res = r.get_obs(depth=True)
